changelog:
v5.2.6 — Steadier playback of large movie files on Fire TV Sticks

• Movies and episodes with very large files (Blu-ray quality video with DTS or TrueHD sound) could stutter, lose sound for a second at a time, and after a few minutes freeze the whole app. The app now keeps a sensible amount of video in memory for these titles, sized to what your device can hold, so they play steadily.

• The "slow connection" tip no longer appears for split-second pauses, or when the slowdown was inside the app rather than on your network. When you see it now, it is about your connection.

• Crash Logs no longer list the system quietly closing Ooustream in the background as a crash.
